notes.title: Major Update 2.00a
notes.content:
After almost 3 years from one of the most important projects of our studio, we’re happy to announce [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1054470/Agent_Lovesdick/]Agent Lovesdick[/url] has received a major update. 

Since you guys really enjoyed the stealth mechanics, we’ve removed the JRPG battles and improved the game mechanics you all enjoyed. Check out a video showing moments of the new gameplay.

https://youtu.be/tkUIFpCmxec

As you can see in the video, now you can hide in shadows, dash and you can actually shoot at your enemies! Also, the boss fighting is completely remade and now it’s much more fun and challenging!

The NSFW scenes are the same as in the old version.

We hope you all enjoy this major update and if you already have the game, you only need to download it. It’s a free update! If you don’t have it, its price increased a little bit, but you can get it with 30% OFF during our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/maledoll/list/62178]May Week-Long Sale 2022[/url]!

Thank you all for supporting us and don’t forget to follow our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/maledoll/]Steam page[/url] to receive the latest news.

Male Doll Team

notes.title: Agent Lovesdick 1.00b
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, guys![/h1]

Thank you all for the feedback about Agent. Since this is our first version bugs can be found, and I'll be glad if you use our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1054470/discussions/]Community Hub[/url] to report them. Based on recent feedback, I’ve made a small patch to fix those bugs that people told me on [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/6nmTCkC]Male Doll's Discord[/url]. Check them:

[list]
[*] Plymouth mountain tileset: in town, you could climb the mountain with a waterfall in the northwest region because one tileset was bugged. This is already fixed.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34834683/d12fddbed060076830142364bb594b6337fbbd41.png[/img]

[list]
[*] After you watched Elf's Coffee scene, the character's speed decreased to half of it. I tried to solve this. This is not a usual bug, but in case this happens, please report it!
[/list]

Last but not least, my new game Cumming Hotel is being developed (some people have already been testing the first unstable build because of our Discord's raffle), and you can follow the process through my [url=https://www.patreon.com/maledollstudio/posts?tag=Dev%20Blog]Patreon's Free Dev Week Blog[/url].

Cheers,

[list]
[*] When you were on Mr. Trumpson's Tournament, on the stairway (specifically), you could walk through the mountain because the floor was bugged;
[*] One of the orcs on West Poll path was bugged - it didn’t disappear after you killed it;
[*] The background of Gleen's Box's Monster had an error;
[*] One slime in Rebel Nymes' Mansion couldn't move, it only turned to the left and to the right;
[*] If you finished the game during the night, you were teleported to the last cutscene and the game turns to day time, but the sky was still dark;
[/list]

[b]The first unstable build of our new game will be launched on [url=https://maledollstudio.itch.io/]Itch.Io[/url] in a few weeks, and you can follow us from there.  Also, if you haven't bought the game yet, enjoy our special discount![/b]

Cheers,
